purpose: Mac-only endgame oracle-guiding training (Suphx/PerfectDou style): champion plays until the endgame threshold, a student learns endgame values with other hands visible only during training, oracle input decays to zero, exported student sees only its own hand. Research experiment; not a web release.
start: Exact copy of champion 017 trunk; oracle projection 162x512 initialized to zero; fresh Adam; empty replay; run steps count from 0 (inherited network step 855042 recorded separately).
target: Decider team's final signed single-round upgrade points (+-1/+-2/+-3), Monte Carlo, MSE. No tempo, trick-control, bomb or partner proxy in reward, loss, gate or acceptance.
rules: Single fresh deals from createRound (random level and leader, no tribute, no cross-round match state), same as the held-out protocols of sections 41/44/46.

actor.note: Endgame = total cards in all hands <= threshold. Before it every decision is champion greedy; at/after it the latest exported student decides with softmax(Q/0.02) and the decision is recorded. Finishing move and single candidate are automatic (as in the web table policy).

learner.oracle: Per-sample keep probability p=max(0,1-step/oracleDecaySteps); kept samples see the other three hands (162 counts relative to the decider), dropped samples see zeros.

seeds.heldout: First 3,000 seeds of the audit's reserved list (985,009,200..985,018,373)
seeds.scope: Audit read 360 locally readable evidence files (69,454 known roots); Windows-only logs not readable from this Mac are unverified.

stop: Fixed deadline 2026-11-08T14:18:02.146Z (original window); restarts use only the remaining time; STOP or deadline stops all processes; no extension, no peak picking.

evaluation.object: The final exported student after the window (models/latest.json at stop), not an intermediate or best-looking export.
evaluation.design: 3,000 held-out deals, each played twice with sides swapped (6,000 single rounds). Focal team plays champion until total cards <= 32 then the student, greedy; the other team plays champion 017 throughout. Finishing move/single candidate automatic; no endgame proof shortcut, no styles.
evaluation.primary: Focal team's mean signed round points per deal pair, 95% deal-cluster normal interval. Positive evidence only if the lower bound > 0.
evaluation.secondary: Wins/losses; number of endgame decisions where student differs from champion; descriptive perfect-information minimax regret on disagreements with <= 18 cards (exact solver, 3 s budget; not an acceptance metric).
evaluation.notCovered: Clint or other opponents, human teammates, tribute and whole-match (pass-A) effects, web integration. Any web use requires a separate preregistered acceptance.

unchanged: Web champion 017 and menu, Windows campaign and all frozen runs, reward definition, GuanZero, tribute specialist.
